heading.en: The iniquity of the people brings a curse upon the land—Coriantumr engages in warfare against Gilead, then Lib, and then Shiz—Blood and carnage cover the land.
heading.sm: O le amioleaga o tagata ua aumai ai se fetuu i luga o le laueleele—Ua tau e Korianetuma se taua e faasaga ia Kiliata, sosoo ai ma Lipi, ona sosoo ai lea ma Sesa—Ua lofia le laueleele i le toto ma tagata oti.

verses.en: And now there began to be a great curse upon all the land because of the iniquity of the people, in which, if a man should lay his tool or his sword upon his shelf, or upon the place whither he would keep it, behold, upon the morrow, he could not find it, so great was the curse upon the land.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa amata ona i ai o se fetuu tele i luga o le laueleele atoa ona o le amioletonu o tagata, lea a tuu ai e se tagata sana meafaigaluega po o lana pelu i luga o lana fata, po o luga o se mea e manao o ia e teu ai, faauta, o le aso e sosoo ai, e le mafai ona ia toe maua, ona o le tetele tele o le fetuu i luga o le laueleele.

verses.en: Wherefore every man did cleave unto that which was his own, with his hands, and would not borrow neither would he lend; and every man kept the hilt of his sword in his right hand, in the defense of his property and his own life and of his wives and children.
verses.sm: O le mea lea sa uumau ai e tagata taitoatasi ana lava mea, i ona lima, ma lē fia nonō mai pe faaune atu e ia; ma sa taitasi le tagata ma uu le au o lana pelu i lona lima taumatau, i le puipuiga o ana meatotino ma lona lava ola, ma ola o ana avā ma fanau.

verses.en: And now, after the space of two years, and after the death of Shared, behold, there arose the brother of Shared and he gave battle unto Coriantumr, in which Coriantumr did beat him and did pursue him to the wilderness of Akish.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, ina ua mavae le va o le lua tausaga, ma ina ua mavae le oti o Sareto, faauta, sa tu mai le uso o Sareto ma tau o ia ma Korianetuma, lea na faatoilalo ai o ia e Korianetuma ma tuliloa ia te ia e oo atu i le vao o Akiso.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the brother of Shared did give battle unto him in the wilderness of Akish; and the battle became exceedingly sore, and many thousands fell by the sword.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina tau le uso o Sareto ma ia i le vao o Akiso; ma sa oo ina matuā tuga tele le taua, ma e afe ma afe na pa’u’ū ai i le pelu.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that Coriantumr did lay siege to the wilderness; and the brother of Shared did march forth out of the wilderness by night, and slew a part of the army of Corian– tumr, as they were drunken.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina si’o e Korianetuma le vao; ma sa savavali atu le uso o Sareto mai le vao i le po, ma fasioti se vaega o le autau a Korianetuma, a’o onanā i latou.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And he came forth to the land of Moron, and placed himself upon the throne of Coriantumr.
verses.sm: Ma sa alu atu o ia i le laueleele o Morona, ma ua nofo o ia lava i luga o le nofoalii o Korianetuma.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Coriantumr dwelt with his army in the wilderness for the space of two years, in which he did receive great strength to his army.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina nonofo Korianetuma ma lana autau i le vao mo le va o le lua tausaga, lea na ia maua ai se malosi tele i lana autau.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: Now the brother of Shared, whose name was Gilead, also received great strength to his army, because of secret combinations.
verses.sm: O lenei, o le uso o Sareto, o lona igoa o Kiliata, sa ia maua foi se malosi tele i lana autau, ona o faapotopotoga faalilolilo.

verses.en: And it came to pass that his high priest murdered him as he sat upon his throne.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fasioti o ia e lana faitaulaga sili a’o nofo o ia i luga o lona nofoalii.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that one of the secret combinations murdered him in a secret pass, and obtained unto himself the kingdom; and his name was Lib; and Lib was a man of great stature, more than any other man among all the people.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fasioti o ia e se tasi o faapotopotoga faalilolilo i totonu o se auala faalilolilo, ma ia maua ai mo ia lava le malo; ma o lona igoa o Lipi; ma o Lipi o se tagata tino ese maualuga, sa sili atu nai lo se isi lava tagata i totonu o le nuu atoa.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that in the first year of Lib, Coriantumr came up unto the land of Moron, and gave battle unto Lib.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo i le tausaga muamua o Lipi, na sau ai Korianetuma i luga i le laueleele o Morona, ma tau ma Lipi.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he fought with Lib, in which Lib did smite upon his arm that he was wounded; nevertheless, the army of Coriantumr did press forward upon Lib, that he fled to the borders upon the seashore.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina tau o ia ma Lipi, lea na ta ai e Lipi lona lima lea na manu’a ai o ia; ae ui i lea, sa fetaomi atu i luma le autau a Korianetuma i luga o Lipi, sa oo ina sola o ia i tuaoi i luga o le matafaga.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that Coriantumr pursued him; and Lib gave battle unto him upon the seashore.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina tuliloa o ia e Korianetuma; ma sa tau o ia ma Lipi i luga o le matafaga.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that Lib did smite the army of Coriantumr, that they fled again to the wilderness of Akish.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina taia e Lipi le autau a Korianetuma, sa oo ina latou toe sosola ai i le vao o Akiso.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that Lib did pursue him until he came to the plains of Agosh. And Coriantumr had taken all the people with him as he fled before Lib in that quarter of the land whither he fled.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina tuliloa o ia e Lipi seia oo ina oo mai o ia i fanua laugatasi o Akosa. Ma sa ave e Korianetuma tagata uma faatasi ma ia a’o sola o ia i luma o Lipi, i le vaega lena o le laueleele na ia sola atu i ai.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And when he had come to the plains of Agosh he gave battle unto Lib, and he smote upon him until he died; nevertheless, the brother of Lib did come against Coriantumr in the stead thereof, and the battle became exceedingly sore, in the which Coriantumr fled again before the army of the brother of Lib.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua oo mai o ia i fanua laugatasi o Akosa, sa tau o ia ma Lipi, ma sa ia taia o ia seia oo ina oti ai; ae ui i lea, sa sau le uso o Lipi e faasaga ia Korianetuma e sui ia te ia, ma sa oo ina matuā tuga tele lava le taua, lea na toe sola ai Korianetuma i luma o le autau a le uso o Lipi.

verses.en: Now the name of the brother of Lib was called Shiz. And it came to pass that Shiz pursued after Coriantumr, and he did overthrow many cities, and he did slay both women and children, and he did burn the cities.
verses.sm: O lenei o le igoa o le uso o Lipi sa ta’ua o Sesa. Ma sa o’o ina tuliloa e Sesa ia Korianetuma, ma sa faatoilalo e ia aai e tele, ma sa ia fasiotia fafine ma tamaiti, ma ia susunu aai.

verses.en: And there went a fear of Shiz throughout all the land; yea, a cry went forth throughout the land—Who can stand before the army of Shiz? Behold, he sweepeth the earth before him!
verses.sm: Ma sa oo atu i le laueleele atoa le fefefe ia Sesa; ioe, sa alu atu se alaga i le laueleele atoa— O ai e mafai ona tu atu i luma o le autau a Sesa? Faauta, ua tafi e ia le laueleele i ona luma!

verses.en: And it came to pass that the people began to flock together in armies, throughout all the face of the land.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina amata ona lolofi faatasi mai tagata i ana autau, i luga o le laueleele atoa.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And they were divided; and a part of them fled to the army of Shiz, and a part of them fled to the army of Coriantumr.
verses.sm: Ma sa vaeluaina i latou; o se vaega o i latou sa sosola atu i le autau a Sesa, ma o se vaega o i latou sa sosola atu i le autau a Korianetuma.

verses.en: And so great and lasting had been the war, and so long had been the scene of bloodshed and carnage, that the whole face of the land was covered with the bodies of the dead.
verses.sm: Ma ona o le tetele tele ma le umi o le taua, ma umi ona avea ma vaaiga o le faamasaa toto ma tagata feoti, sa oo ina ufitia ai luga o le laueleele atoa i tino o tagata oti.

w.en: all the face of the land
with the bodies of the dead.

verses.en: And so swift and speedy was the war that there was none left to bury the dead, but they did march forth from the shedding of blood to the shedding of blood, leaving the bodies of both men, women, and children strewed upon the face of the land, to become a prey to the worms of the flesh.
verses.sm: Ma sa televave ma taalise tele le taua sa leai ni isi na totoe e tanumia tagata oti, ae sa latou savavali atu i luma mai i le faamasaaina o le toto i le faamasaaina o le toto, ma tuu ai tino o tane, fafine, ma tamaiti e salalau solo i luga o le laueleele, e fai ma meaai a anufe o le tino.

verses.en: And the scent thereof went forth upon the face of the land, even upon all the face of the land; wherefore the people became troubled by day and by night, because of the scent thereof.
verses.sm: Ma ua alu atu lo latou manogi i luga o le laueleele, ioe, i luga o le laueleele atoa uma lava; o le mea lea na mafatia ai tagata i le ao ma le po, ona o le manogi na i ai.

verses.en: Nevertheless, Shiz did not cease to pursue Coriantumr; for he had sworn to avenge himself upon Coriantumr of the blood of his brother, who had been slain, and the word of the Lord which came to Ether that Coriantumr should not fall by the sword.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, sa le tuua e Sesa le tuliloaina o Korianetuma; ona sa tauto o ia o le a ia taui i luga o Korianetuma le toto o lona uso, o lē ua fasiotia, ma le fetalaiga a le Alii lea na oo mai ia Eteru e faapea o le a le oti lava Korianetuma i le pelu.

verses.en: And thus we see that the Lord did visit them in the fulness of his wrath, and their wickedness and abominations had prepared a way for their everlasting destruction.
verses.sm: Ma ua faapea ona tatou vaai ai sa asiasi mai lava le Alii ia te i latou i le atoatoa o lona toasa, ma ua saunia e lo latou amioleaga ma a latou mea inosia se ala mo lo latou faaumatiaina e faavavau.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Shiz did pursue Coriantumr eastward, even to the borders by the seashore, and there he gave battle unto Shiz for the space of three days.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina tuliloa e Sesa ia Korianetuma agai i sasae, seia oo mai lava i tuaoi i tafatafa o le matafaga, ma o iina na tau ai o ia ma Sesa mo le va o aso e tolu.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And so terrible was the destruction among the armies of Shiz that the people began to be frightened, and began to flee before the armies of Coriantumr; and they fled to the land of Corihor, and swept off the inhabitants before them, all them that would not join them.
verses.sm: Ma sa matuā matautia tele le faafanoga i totonu o autau a Sesa sa amata ona matata’u tagata, ma amata ona sosola mai luma o autau a Korianetuma; ma sa latou sosola atu i le laueleele o Kori’oa, ma tafi ese mai o latou luma tagata sa nonofo ai, i latou uma ia o ē sa le fia au faatasi ma i latou.

verses.en: And they pitched their tents in the valley of Corihor; and Coriantumr pitched his tents in the valley of Shurr. Now the valley of Shurr was near the hill Comnor; wherefore, Coriantumr did gather his armies together upon the hill Comnor, and did sound a trumpet unto the armies of Shiz to invite them forth to battle.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou faatutū o latou faleie i le vanu o Kori’oa; ma sa faatutū e Korianetuma ona faleie i le vanu o Suro. O lenei o le vanu o Suro sa latalata i le maupu’epu’e o Kominoa; o le mea lea, na faapotopoto faatasi ai e Korianetuma ana autau i luga o le maupu’epu’e o Kominoa, ma ili atu se pu i autau a Sesa e valaau atu ai ia te i latou e o mai e tau.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they came forth, but were driven again; and they came the second time, and they were driven again the second time. And it came to pass that they came again the third time, and the battle became exceedingly sore.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou o mai, peitai sa toe tulia i latou; ma sa latou o mai faalua, ma sa toe tulia foi i latou i le taimi lona lua. Ma sa oo ina latou toe o mai i le taimi lona tolu, ma sa oo ina tugā tele lava le taua.

w.en: And it came to pass that
And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that Shiz smote upon Coriantumr that he gave him many deep wounds; and Coriantumr, having lost his blood, fainted, and was carried away as though he were dead.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina taia e Sesa ia Korianetuma ma sa oo ina ia faaoo atu ia te ia ni manu’a loloto e tele; ma o Korianetuma, ona o le tele o lona toto ua masaa, na matapogia, ma sa aveese atu o ia e peiseai ua oti.

w.en: And it came to pass that
of his blood that was shed,

verses.en: Now the loss of men, women and children on both sides was so great that Shiz commanded his people that they should not pursue the armies of Coriantumr; wherefore, they returned to their camp.
verses.sm: O lenei ona o le toatele naua o tane, fafine, ma tamaiti na fasiotia i itu uma e lua, o lea na faatonu ai e Sesa ona tagata ia aua nei o latou tuliloaina autau a Korianetuma; o le mea lea, na latou toe foi atu ai i la latou togalauapi.
